Coincubation with a soluble competitor, lactose, efficiently blocked binding (Fig. 2B), indicating that interactions were glycan-dependent.
We also observed a dose-dependent increase in fluorescence with increasing amounts (25 to 100 nM) of PX-Gal3
Here we used a proximity labeling approach that catalytically tags interactors for galectin-3
Peptides were then analyzed with a Thermo Fisher Scientific Orbitrap Fusion Lumos proteomic mass spectrometer
analyzed with a Thermo Fisher Scientific Orbitrap Fusion Lumos proteomic mass spectrometer in a data-dependent manner
Peptide fragmentation for MS2 was performed via collision-induced dissociation (CID)... The MS3 precursor was fragmented via high-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD)
CID collision energy 30%... fragmented via high-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) with a collision energy of 65%
fragment ion mass tolerance was set to 0.6 Da
The precursor mass tolerance was set to 10 ppm
P values were obtained using t tests with two biological replicates
